title: Modular Arithmetic
description: Arithmetic on a clock: 9 + 5 is 2 on a twelve-hour dial. Fermat and Euler found its rules, and every cipher that keeps a secret on the open internet runs on them.

puzzle.goal: p and q are two different primes. Write φ, how many numbers below pq share no factor with pq.
puzzle.name: Coprime count
puzzle.ask: Find φ for p = @{p} and q = @{q}.
puzzle.method: Of the pq numbers, q are multiples of p and p are multiples of q, and pq itself was counted twice: pq − p − q + 1.
